stem: Radha has a frequency table that shows how many children chose each fruit for the class picnic. She now wants to pair each child with the fruit that child chose.

options.text: The individual records, because the frequency table keeps category totals but not which child chose which fruit.
The frequency table alone, because the table is already the list of individual child choices.
Only the frequency table, even though she must match each child to one fruit.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: A frequency table keeps how many chose each fruit but drops which child chose which fruit, so pairing needs the individual records.

teacher.key_rationale: Person–item matching needs individual records. Treating the frequency table as those records swaps labels. Using only totals while needing matches omits that condition.
